𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗘𝗘 𝗗𝗢𝗨𝗕𝗟𝗘𝗦! 🔥

Patel 210*, Sanvir Singh 205 and Pradosh Paul 208 all hit Ranji Trophy double hundreds on Day 2.

Urvil's was his maiden first-class 200 👏
